gripOrHq.title: Omnitech Wet Drive
gripOrHq.rulesText: Your base MU is equal to the number of cards in your hand instead of 4.

gripOrHq.title: Corruption
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if you scored any agendas this turn. Lose all agenda points you scored this turn, and the Corp scores that many agenda points. Gain [10] per agenda point lost in this way, and the Corp gives you a tag.

gripOrHq.title: Do the 'Drine
gripOrHq.rulesText: Suffer any amount of brain damage, but not enough to flatline you or to reduce your hand size to less than 0. Gain [4] for each point of brain damage you suffer in this way. This damage cannot be prevented.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Corruption
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you scored any agendas this turn. Lose all agenda points you scored this turn, and the Corp scores that many agenda points. Gain [10] per agenda point lost in this way, and the Corp gives you a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Meat Upgrade
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Boostergang Connections
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Trash your hand. Search your stack for as many cards as were successfully trashed in this way and bring them into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterward.

heapOrArchives.title: Library Search
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D or HQ. If run is successful, access two additional cards if you used no noisy icebreakers during the run and if no trace attempts were made during the run.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

rig.title: Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cybermodem
rig.rulesText: Provides +1 Mu. Put [2] from the bank on Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cybermodem when it is installed. Use this bits only to pay for using icebreakers during runs or increasing your link. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn. At the start of each of your turns roll a die. On a 1, suffer 2 brain damage. This damage cannot be prevented. If Omnitech "Spinal Tap" Cyermodem leaves play suffer 2 brain damage. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

rig.title: Zetatech Portastation
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Zetatech Portastation when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for playing preps. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Executive File Clerk
rig.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Sandbox Dig
rig.rulesText: [3], [T]: Look at the top three cards stored in R&D. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Retreat
scoreArea.rulesText: You lose the following ability as soon as you rez or install any card. A: Gain [2].

root.title: Management Shake-Up
root.rulesText: Add three advancement counters to any combination of installed cards that can be advanced.

root.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
root.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

ice.title: Razor Wire
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 2 net damage.
[Subroutine] End the run.
